findings.test: REQ-002 AC4: Any later bid is accepted only if it is at least 1 unit of the item currency higher than the current highest bid, otherwise it is rejected.
findings.explanation: After a first bid of 100 was accepted, a second bid of 100 from another bidder was accepted. The minimum bid rule for later bids (highest + 1) is not enforced, or the item's highest bid is not updated and saved via saveItem after an accepted bid (per SEQ-003).
findings.proposedFix: In BidService.placeBid, set item.highestBidAmount and highestBidderId after saveBid and call itemStore.saveItem(item). Make Item.minimumBid() return highestBidAmount + 1 when a bid exists, else startingPrice, and reject amounts below it.

findings.test: REQ-002 AC4: Any later bid is accepted only if it is at least 1 unit of the item currency higher than the current highest bid, otherwise it is rejected.
findings.explanation: After a first bid of 100 was accepted, a second bid of 100 (not at least 1 higher) resolved instead of rejecting. The test is consistent with the criterion, so the minimum bid check is wrong. Possible causes: the highest bid is not updated on the item after the first bid, or the comparison allows equal amounts.
findings.proposedFix: In BidService.placeBid, once an item has a highest bid, reject any amount below highestBidAmount + 1. Make sure an accepted bid sets item.highestBidAmount and highestBidderId and the item is saved with saveItem.

testFixes.reason: AuctionCloser.tick closes auctions due at the current time; the item had an end time in 2030, so it was not due. Item now ends in the past.
The fake socket lacked readyState, which every WebSocket in the Map<string, WebSocket> API has; added an open readyState.

testFixes.test: REQ-005 AC1: A bidder who selects CHF, EUR or USD sees item prices and bids converted with a rate obtained from Frankfurter.
testFixes.reason: The fake item did not follow the Item shape (highestBid instead of highestBidAmount); fixed the shared fixture, which affects all UC-006 tests that failed with the amount error.

testFixes.test: SEQ-006 scenario: View prices in display currency
testFixes.reason: Display currency CHF equals the item currency CHF, so no rates need fetching; the scenario now uses EUR so a conversion and fetch is required.
GET /api/items/:id returns an ItemView (item nested), so title is read from body.item.

testFixes.test: REQ-005 AC1: A bidder who selects CHF, EUR or USD sees item prices and bids converted with a rate obtained from Frankfurter.
testFixes.reason: Fake item used a non-existent field highestBid; Item attribute is highestBidAmount. Fixed shared helper (also affects REQ-005 AC3, AC4, REQ-010 AC3, SEQ-006).
Topic name 'bid' was guessed and is not in the design; events now come from the real BidEventPublisher (also REQ-007 AC1, AC2).

testFixes.test: REQ-010 AC3: When Frankfurter cannot be reached and no valid cached rate exists, prices are shown only in the item currency and bidding still works.
testFixes.reason: The assertion that displayCurrency is null is not required by the criterion or design; the criterion only requires no converted prices. Removed it, kept the null converted prices checks.
